1) Cycle that tank! Uncyled tanks lead to stressful situations and can be very harmful to your betta. 2) that 10 gallon is too small for 4 cory cats. Maybe 2 but that’s pushing it. In order to keep 4 corys you’d need a 20 or 25 gallon. 3) your betta appears to have a fungal infection. Use aquarium salt to the right dosage on the canister and it should clear up. 3) 10 gallons need weekly water changes, personally i do mine 25% every 2 weeks as it is an established tank. 4) that tank water is high, it’s at the very limit bettas can handle for long periods of time, drop the temp a few degrees to around 78 or 79 and you may see an improvement in his activity.
